# Contract: test-driven-development

Third-party skill from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) (MIT, Jesse Vincent), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Test-first implementation). The method is upstream. Category: engineering. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Write a failing test first, then the minimum code that makes it pass.

## Use it for
- "build this test-first"
- "use TDD for this behaviour"

## Not for
- an intermittent failure (flaky-test-killer)
- a speed comparison (benchmark-honestly)

## Accepted inputs
A behaviour to add or change in a repository the user owns.

## Deliverables
